  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">ROATAN BOUTIQUE HOTEL</h2></div>

</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-161b4e00dfa511296333"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="161b4e00dfa511296333" id="block-161b4e00dfa511296333"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>The Island Trip You Imagined — Uncrowded, Unhurried, Unforgettable</strong></p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Welcome to Camp Bay Lodge, a beachfront hideaway on Roatán’s quiet East End — the part of the island where time slows down, the breeze softens, and the Caribbean feels exactly like you hoped it would.</p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Here, you won’t find crowds, noise, or hurried schedules.<br> Instead, you’ll discover <strong>wide-open horizons, space to breathe, honest nature, and a rhythm of life that feels beautifully simple.</strong></p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Every room sits just steps from the sea, surrounded by local hardwoods, natural textures, and the kind of calm you only get on this side of the island. Walk outside your door and choose your moment: a hammock under the palms, a beach lounger facing turquoise water, a sunrise stretch on our open-air yoga deck.</p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">This is the Caribbean the way travelers imagine it — and rarely find.</p></div>

</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-yui_3_17_2_1_1782889437303_9329"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1782889437303_9329" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1782889437303_9329"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Explore the East End at Your Own Pace</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">From Camp Bay Lodge, adventure feels effortless — never rushed, never crowded.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">We’re minutes from Roatán’s most scenic, uncrowded reef sites. Whether snorkeling or diving, the water here is clear, quiet, and full of life. Prefer to stay above the surface? Drift through mangroves, paddleboard at sunrise, kayak along the shoreline, or join a boat loop to the island’s hidden corners.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">And for those drawn to the wind, the East End offers some of the best kitesurfing conditions in the Caribbean.<br>We have on-site launching and landing areas, plus Kitesurfing lessons with experienced instructors who put safety first and fun second — but very close behind. Please contact us to book lessons before your stay.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Here, adventure fits the day, not the other way around.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">About the hotel</h2></div>
<style id="container-styles"></style>
<style id="override-container-styles"></style>
<style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>

</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-f24c2eba5968b58cbe28"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="f24c2eba5968b58cbe28" id="block-f24c2eba5968b58cbe28"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Where Nature, Simplicity, and Soul Meet</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Camp Bay Lodge was created around a simple idea: that the most meaningful luxuries are space, calm, and connection — to nature, to others, and to yourself.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our stretch of Roatán’s East End is still wild and wonderfully untouched. Turquoise beaches meet mangroves and lush vegetation filled with birds, iguanas, armadillos, and butterflies. Horses wander. Farmers pass by with fresh melons and plantains. The village of Camp Bay brings an authentic, peaceful “country island” charm you won’t find elsewhere.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">This is a place that feels honest, warm, and real.<br> A place to rest deeply.<br> A place to explore gently.<br> A place where your own story shapes the experience.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Welcome to the island trip you imagined — finally brought to life.</p></div>
